title: 目標達成の後に・拍動、強く

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap continues to do well in her races. It's obvious to any onlooker that she's a skilled runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eyes firmly set on the Arima Kinen, she begins training once again.
